title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China in the Macao Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en:
1. All Macao residents of Chinese descent who were born in Chinese territory (including Macao), and other persons who meet the conditions for Chinese nationality prescribed by the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, regardless of whether they hold Portuguese travel documents or identity documents, shall be Chinese citizens.
Any Macao Special Administrative Region resident of Chinese descent but also of Portuguese descent may, according to his or her own will, choose the nationality of the People's Republic of China or the nationality of the Republic of Portugal. Upon determination of one nationality, he or she shall not have the other nationality. The aforesaid Macao Special Administrative Region residents, before making the choice of nationality, shall enjoy the rights prescribed by the Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region, except the rights subject to restriction by nationality.

2. Any Chinese citizen of Macao who holds a Portuguese travel document may, after the establishment of the Macao Special Administrative Region, continue to use such document to travel to other countries or regions, but shall not, by reason of holding the aforesaid Portuguese travel document, enjoy the right of Portuguese consular protection in the Macao Special Administrative Region or other parts of the People's Republic of China.

3. Any Chinese citizen of the Macao Special Administrative Region who has the right of abode in a foreign country may use the relevant documents issued by the foreign government to travel to other countries or regions, but shall not, by reason of holding the aforesaid documents, enjoy the right of foreign consular protection in the Macao Special Administrative Region or other parts of the People's Republic of China.

4. Any Chinese citizen who was originally a Macao resident and returns to Macao from overseas before or after the establishment of the Macao Special Administrative Region may, if changing nationality, declare the change to the authority of the Macao Special Administrative Region handling nationality applications by presenting valid documents.

5. The Government of the Macao Special Administrative Region is authorized to designate its relevant organs to handle all matters concerning nationality applications in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and the provisions above.
